chain: Second sweep accumulates direct upward cotangent, full readout cotangent, and all direct shared-parameter contributions.
Complete frozen history differentiates both directions, every window carry, pooling and readout-minus-forcing; ell_theta contribution is added once.
Forcing differentiates both first-sweep upward/outside boundaries plus memory.U; forcing upward cotangent is added to direct second-sweep cotangent.
First sweep jointly differentiates both outputs with their total cotangents; shared site/base/gate/sweep parameters accumulate first- and second-sweep contributions.
Autograd returns trunk parameter contributions without mutating .grad; unused decoder/GRU parameters return None, preserving previously accumulated decoder gradients.
limits: Only first-order training VJPs supported, matching the declared scope.
Current frozen trunk has no stochastic operators; recomputation does not save per-block RNG and must not be generalized to changed stochastic trunks.
CPU boundaries retain full first upward/outside arrays and full direct-upward cotangents; whole-parent host memory still requires measurement.
Numerical parity must cover normal decoder-backward then context.backward, all49 final parameter gradients and one clipped optimizer update.
Source alone does not prove GPU/host memory fit or runtime improvement.
actions: Static source review only; no code execution, models, labels or jobs run by reviewer.
